name: Boldness Holy
overview: Scripture presents holy boldness as a confident approach to God grounded in faith and reverence, exemplified by Abraham's courageous intercession before the LORD. In Genesis 18, Abraham stands firm and respectfully pleads with God to spare the righteous in Sodom, demonstrating that boldness before God involves both trust in His justice and a willingness to engage Him in prayer. This passage highlights that holy boldness is not presumption but a faithful expression of dependence on God's righteousness and mercy.
